page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Senior Multi-Cloud Platform & Automation Engineer
headline: Senior Multi-Cloud Platform & Automation Engineer | GCP, Azure, AWS Migration, Go (Golang), Temporal & Terraform
summary_html: Senior Multi-Cloud Platform & Automation Engineer with 10 years of hands-on experience operating, maintaining, automating, and transitioning enterprise cloud environments across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and AWS. Strong track record supporting legacy cloud environments through structured maintenance, operational troubleshooting, security hardening, and phased decommissioning processes while consolidating and migrating components into target AWS architectures. Direct hands-on coding proficiency in Go (Golang) and Python for building cloud platform services and cloud automation tooling. Deep expertise in workflow orchestration using Temporal to automate complex, multi-step cloud provisioning, subscription lifecycle management, and decommissioning workflows. Expert in Terraform (Google, AzureRM, AWS providers) for repeatable infrastructure provisioning, automated state manipulation, and resource retirement. Proven ability to partner with Cloud Foundations teams, enforce least-privilege security controls, resolve high-priority infrastructure incidents, and author standard operational runbooks in remote, fast-paced enterprise environments (Dallas, TX / CST).

achievements.text: Maintained, stabilized, and secured legacy GCP and Azure environments throughout complex decommissioning lifecycles, safely executing resource drain, dependency decoupling, and migration of critical workloads into AWS.

Engineered resilient, stateful workflow orchestration services in Go using Temporal—building durable sagas and task queues for automated cloud subscription provisioning, resource cleanup, and operational lifecycle automation.
Authored and maintained modular Terraform configurations and Python automation scripts for Azure and GCP subscription lifecycle management, policy enforcement, and infrastructure reconciliation.
Served as Tier 2/3 operational escalation lead, resolving critical cloud infrastructure incidents, network routing anomalies, and security vulnerabilities across legacy and target cloud estates.
Partnered with enterprise Cloud Foundations and security stakeholders to establish guardrails, least-privilege IAM controls, secrets rotation, and comprehensive troubleshooting runbooks.
